messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered - incident capacity_exhaustion_inference_queue

incident-bot: Page details: service=redwood-inference-autoscaler, severity=high, symptom=queue_backlog>5000, threshold=3m

Sara L: acked. I'm jumping on it. What's current impact? :thinking_face:

Mike H: seeing 4x normal queue depth on inference-queue-prod. Autoscaler didn't add nodes for the last 6m.

Jordan L: Confirming - queue lag spiked after a big internal batch job hit /v1/embeddings. Prefix cache cold, per-request latency up and backlog growing.

customer-support: we've seen 12 customers with 5xxs (timeout) reported in last 10m. No SLO yet but users are affected.

Sara L: ok. First priority = stop further queue growth. Options: manual scale up (spin new nodes), temporarily throttle internal batch job, enable fallback model route. Who can do manual spinup?

Mike H: I can spin nodes. Running the standard spinup script now.

Mike H:
```
# manual node add
kubectl scale deploy/autoscaler-worker --replicas=12 -n inference-prod
# verify pods
kubectl get pods -n inference-prod | grep worker | tail -n 5
```

Mike H: command issued. New pods are Pending - looks like node group quota is hit in us-east-1.

Jordan L: that's consistent with quota throttle. We have 0 spare nodes in the shared pool. Can we burst to reserved capacity?

Sara L: Ping dedicated infra team. @ops-bot request reserve-burst us-east-1 +2 g4dn

ops-bot: request received. Eng-infra notified. ETA ~4m to attach capacity.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalate to L2 (capacity-ops) in 5m if unacked.

Mike H: meanwhile I'm going to reroute non-essential traffic to lower-cost models and enable aggressive batching on the host gateway.

Mike H:
```
# enable throttle for internal jobs
curl -X POST https://internal.apps/realtime-config -d '{"ingress_rate_limit": 0.5, "target_routes": ["/v1/embeddings/bulk"]}'
```

Jordan L: routing change applied. Observability: queue growth slowed from +200/s to +40/s after throttle.

Sara L: good. Customer-impact update: CS reports timeouts for paid customers on writes to embeddings; escalate to CS lead.

customer-support: escalated to CS lead, who will open priority tickets. Tracking link: https://support.redwood/example-ticket/1234

ops-bot: infra update: we've provisioned 2 extra GPU instances in us-east-1 but they need kube join. Kubecloud reports join timing ~3m.

Mike H: I see new nodes becoming Ready, starting to schedule pods.

Jordan L: KV cache warmup still needed — cold cache means first requests still slow. Suggest pre-warming common prefixes: running warmup against top 50 prefixes.

Jordan L:
```
python tools/warmup_prefixes.py --env prod --top 50 --parallel 10
```

Sara L: go for it. Also set temporary fallback policy to a quantized model to reduce resource pressure.

Mike H: fallback policy applied: model=rq-quantized-small, route=embedding-fallback

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by Sara L. Escalation cancelled.

Mike H: pods are scaling up, backlog starting to drain. Current queue depth: 1800 -> 900 in last 6m.

Jordan L: latency 95p down from 18s to 7s. Errors from timeouts decreased but still ~1.2% on write path.

Sara L: timeline and actions for postmortem:
- root cause: sudden internal batch causing sustained high concurrency + autoscaler unable to provision due to node quota exhaustion
- mitigations: manual throttling, reserve burst, manual node add, model fallback, KV warmup
- followups: increase pool headroom for inference-prod, autoscaler quota alert, block large internal bulk jobs during peak hours, improve warmup automation

customer-support: CS updated customers, offering mitigations and tracking tickets.

Mike H: recommend adding a circuit-breaker that rejects large bulk requests when queue>2000, and a faster autoscaler path that can fallback to spot+quantized models.

Sara L: agreed. I'll create the incident ticket and schedule a 1hr postmortem sync with infra + ML infra + product.

Sara L: closing notes: service back to healthy, continuing to monitor for 30m. Thanks for quick responses :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Monitoring: queue depth stabilized at ~300; no new PD pages in last 10m.

incident-bot: Incident closed (auto) — duration 00:22:59. Log: https://infra-logs/redwood/incidents/1766554321
